name: Pressure Washer Unloader Valve
definition: A primary pressure-control valve that directs pump flow to the discharge path or bypass when demand changes; actuation type, flow, pressure, temperature, ports, bypass plumbing and relief strategy must be engineered together.
includedScope: Integral, bolt-on and externally plumbed configurations
Pressure, flow, temperature, port and bypass checks
excludedScope: Field pressure adjustment without a gauge and manufacturer procedure
headline: An unloader is the primary pressure-control device—not the system's only safety relief.
description: This profile compares trapped-pressure, pressure-sensitive and specialty unloaders using official flow, pressure, temperature and plumbing evidence.
metaDescription: Pressure washer unloader valve types, pressure and flow ratings, bypass plumbing, ports, adjustment and safety compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, mechanical, electrical and fluid interfaces, rated operating envelope, protection requirements and approved service documentation.

architectures.name: Trapped-pressure unloader
architectures.operatingPrinciple: Downstream pressure remains trapped after the trigger closes while pump flow moves to bypass.
architectures.applicationBoundary: Single- or named multi-gun system within product ratings
benefits: Fast pressure availability and established architecture
limitations: Trigger release can create hose pressure and kickback
